name: Fu Chun Shin Machinery Manufacture Co., Ltd.
summary: Fu Chun Shin Machinery Manufacture Co., Ltd. (FCS), established in 1974 and based in Tainan, Taiwan, operates globally, focusing on the production, processing, trade, and repair of plastic injection machinery, molds, electric wires, cables, and various plastic items. The company offers an extensive range of single-injection molding machines, including advanced all-electric, hydraulic, outward toggle, and two-platen models. Their lineup also features high-speed machines for thin-wall and PET preform applications, energy-efficient servo power-saving systems, and the specialized SA-h IMM for producing PET blood collection tubes. For complex molding tasks, FCS manufactures multi-injection systems such as rotary table and shaft two-component, sandwich/interval, and horizontal rotary table two-component injection molding machines. Additionally, they provide specialized equipment designed for materials like thermosetting plastics, BMC, PVC pipes, and PET performs. Beyond machinery, FCS delivers comprehensive solutions, including turnkey services for mold labeling and beverage packaging, high-precision injection molds, and intelligent manufacturing systems. They also supply gas-assisted and foaming injection molding systems. FCS products find diverse applications across numerous sectors, such as medical devices, automotive components, packaging, electronic goods, optical elements, housewares, logistics, building components, and PVC fittings.
